Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Please create a document titled `Expansion Assist Q4 second-cohort candidate audit`. Build a candidate-audit worksheet for the historical cohort, using an eligibility-check date of October 15, 2024. Include each candidate’s qualifying product-visible usage-ceiling crossing date, the event’s age in days at the check, and a pass/fail result under the cohort’s applicable recency rule. Candidates: - EA-104 — crossing date: October 8, 2024 - EA-219 — crossing date: September 24, 2024 - EA-337 — crossing date: October 14, 2024 Also state the rule or calculation used so an auditor can reproduce the results.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Expansion Assist Q4 second-cohort candidate audit", "body": "# Expansion Assist Q4 second-cohort candidate audit

**Eligibility-check date:** October 15, 2024  
**Scope:** Product-visible usage-ceiling crossing recency for the historical second Q4 cohort. Other eligibility conditions are not assessed in this worksheet.

| Candidate | Qualifying product-visible usage-ceiling crossing date | Event age at check (days) | Recency result |
|---|---|---:|---|
| EA-104 | October 8, 2024 | 7 | Pass |
| EA-219 | September 24, 2024 | 21 | Fail |
| EA-337 | October 14, 2024 | 1 | Pass |

## Rule and reproducible calculation

The second-cohort rule requires the product-visible usage ceiling to have been **newly crossed within the preceding 14 days**. For each candidate, calculate the age in calendar days as **October 15, 2024 minus the crossing date**. Pass this recency check when the resulting age is from **0 through 14 days, inclusive**; otherwise fail. Thus, ages of 7 and 1 days pass, while 21 days fails.

A pass here means only that the usage-ceiling event meets the recency requirement; it does not establish that the candidate satisfies the cohort's other eligibility checks.", "folder": null}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_082_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The document body is an auditable worksheet using October 15, 2024 as the eligibility-check date. It includes EA-104 with an October 8, 2024 crossing date and age 7 days marked Pass; EA-219 with a September 24, 2024 crossing date and age 21 days marked Fail; and EA-337 with an October 14, 2024 crossing date and age 1 day marked Pass. It must state or clearly encode that passing requires the product-visible usage ceiling to have been newly crossed within the prior/preceding 14 days, so the displayed outcomes are reproducible. Equivalent table layouts and wording are acceptable, but missing or contradictory dates, calculations, rule, or outcomes fail.", "value": {"title": "Expansion Assist Q4 second-cohort candidate audit", "body": "# Expansion Assist Q4 second-cohort candidate audit

**Eligibility-check date:** October 15, 2024  
**Scope:** Product-visible usage-ceiling crossing recency for the historical second Q4 cohort. Other eligibility conditions are not assessed in this worksheet.

| Candidate | Qualifying product-visible usage-ceiling crossing date | Event age at check (days) | Recency result |
|---|---|---:|---|
| EA-104 | October 8, 2024 | 7 | Pass |
| EA-219 | September 24, 2024 | 21 | Fail |
| EA-337 | October 14, 2024 | 1 | Pass |

## Rule and reproducible calculation

The second-cohort rule requires the product-visible usage ceiling to have been **newly crossed within the preceding 14 days**. For each candidate, calculate the age in calendar days as **October 15, 2024 minus the crossing date**. Pass this recency check when the resulting age is from **0 through 14 days, inclusive**; otherwise fail. Thus, ages of 7 and 1 days pass, while 21 days fails.
